videos.script: The planner keeps its sessions in memory today. Later, in a file, and then in a database on the phone. The screen that shows the week should not have to change each time. {{iface}} An interface is how it does not. A promise that several classes can keep. {{inherit}} Then inheritance, which Kotlin makes a decision. Every class is final unless it says open, and you will see why that is a feature. {{by}} Delegation, with the word by. A class that is a list, forwards everything to a real list, and changes only what it needs to. And the members it does not forward. {{lazy}} By works on properties too: lazy, observable, a map. {{ext}} Last, extension functions. A function added to a type you did not write, which is how most of the standard library you have used was written. And the one rule that keeps them safe: a member always wins.
